title: Lattice Gauging Interfaces and Noninvertible Defects in Higher Dimensions
summary: We study gauging interfaces and their defect descendants in lattice models with generalized symmetries in higher dimensions. We construct explicit interface Hamiltonians for gauging a $\mathbb Z_2^{(0)}$ symmetry in $(2+1)d$ and a $\mathbb Z_2^{(1)}$ symmetry in $(3+1)d$. In higher dimensions, and especially in the presence of higher-form symmetries, the topological nature of gauging interfaces is obscured by the fact that the constrained Hilbert space depends on the location of the interface.
